disposition: The reviewed long-period trials select minima from much faster repeating variability, visible throughout the broad SAP and PDC folds. They are not promoted as planet candidates. The automatic alias-power heuristic narrowly misses its threshold; the manual rejection uses the repeating holdout waveform and the fixed short-period diagnostic.
limitations: This rejection applies to the listed trials. The variable source and physical cause are not localized or established. Nominal scores and post-review subtraction are diagnostics, not calibrated false-alarm probabilities or independent validation; other planets are not ruled out.
